question: Does integrating uncertain copying groups retain useful evidence without requiring perfectly supplied source labels?
scope: Initial supplied-law information ruler under original native laws. Eight development worlds and 64 current cases per world, context-current evidence, no trainable fits or confirmation. This finite subset does not exhaust learned provenance or wider regimes.

graphs: balanced assignment shuffled across report positions
source_id_interventions: independent replacement by a uniform label, including the original

report_model: Each root draws one binary route-preference cue with reliability .8 conditional on the current maker. All reports from that root copy its cue exactly. The root count and cue/noise reliabilities are supplied equally where used. Maker identity and true root assignments remain evaluator-only, except the explicitly supplied-provenance arm.

readers.supplied-roots: Use one likelihood per true independent root; a privileged provenance diagnostic.
readers.inferred-groups: Marginalize all onto labelled copying assignments with a uniform prior, using observed reports and the supplied source-ID error channel. Balanced graphs are a prespecified prior-mismatch challenge.
readers.naive-independent: Multiply every report likelihood as if independent; ignore source labels.
readers.conservative-envelope: Enumerate feasible numbers of zero/one roots given reports and the supplied root count; project the current goal probability onto that posterior interval, then mix the goal-conditioned target distributions. This conservative decision rule is not a graph posterior or a general minimax solution.

matching: All readers, rates and label interventions share current cases, root outcomes and copying graphs within a geometry. Compare random and balanced graph populations within worlds, not by treating reports or cells as independent worlds. Replace source labels by a bijection to verify numerical permutation invariance.
checks: Known copying null: repeated copies preserve the one-root posterior
Contradictory independent cues return equal goal likelihood
Independent used-root-set dynamic program against inclusion-exclusion
Complete serialization and two consumer replays
Full frozen scientific family replay before acceptance
scoring: Uncapped joint log loss, full multiclass Brier, modal/bit accuracy, confident errors and all retained score diagnostics. Whole-world paired intervals. Keep root-count, reliability and generator-law privileges distinct from learned provenance. No changed-execution result is claimed by this native subset.
duplicates: At one root label replacement cannot change labels. At zero intervention hidden and corrupt conditions coincide. Balanced and random graphs may coincide at degenerate geometries; such rows are controls, not additional independent evidence.
repair: One pre-admission repair converts a NumPy boolean control to a JSON-safe Python boolean. Failed source and consumer output are retained; probabilities and thresholds were unchanged. No further family repair is available.
stopping: Complete the finite original-law group and one full replay once; evaluate whether inferred-group gain survives label permutation and balanced graphs. Preserve reversals and dependencies on supplied root count/noise. Wider laws and learned source models remain conditional. D04/B04/B05 and eligible new-world branches remain independent successors. No additional F03 category is claimed.
